005package org.wpilib.math.kinematics;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose2d;
008import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
009import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
010
011/**
012 * Class for swerve drive odometry. Odometry allows you to track the robot's position on the field
013 * over a course of a match using readings from your swerve drive encoders and swerve azimuth
014 * encoders.
015 *
016 * <p>Teams can use odometry during the autonomous period for complex tasks like path following.
017 * Furthermore, odometry can be used for latency compensation when using computer-vision systems.
018 */
019public class SwerveDriveOdometry extends Odometry<SwerveModulePosition[]> {
020  private final int m_numModules;
021
022  /**
023   * Constructs a SwerveDriveOdometry object.
024   *
025   * @param kinematics The swerve drive kinematics for your drivetrain.
026   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
027   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
028   * @param modulePositions The wheel positions reported by each module.
029   * @param initialPose The starting position of the robot on the field.
030   */
031  public SwerveDriveOdometry(
032      SwerveDriveKinematics kinematics,
033      Rotation2d gyroAngle,
034      SwerveModulePosition[] modulePositions,
035      Pose2d initialPose) {
036    super(kinematics, gyroAngle, modulePositions, initialPose);
037
038    m_numModules = modulePositions.length;
039
040    UsageReporting.reportUsage("SwerveDriveOdometry", "");
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Constructs a SwerveDriveOdometry object with the default pose at the origin.
045   *
046   * @param kinematics The swerve drive kinematics for your drivetrain.
047   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
048   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
049   * @param modulePositions The wheel positions reported by each module.
050   */
051  public SwerveDriveOdometry(
052      SwerveDriveKinematics kinematics,
053      Rotation2d gyroAngle,
054      SwerveModulePosition[] modulePositions) {
055    this(kinematics, gyroAngle, modulePositions, Pose2d.ZERO);
056  }
057
058  @Override
059  public void resetPosition(
060      Rotation2d gyroAngle, SwerveModulePosition[] modulePositions, Pose2d pose) {
061    if (modulePositions.length != m_numModules) {
062      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
063          "Number of modules is not consistent with number of wheel locations provided in "
064              + "constructor");
065    }
066    super.resetPosition(gyroAngle, modulePositions, pose);
067  }
068
069  @Override
070  public Pose2d update(Rotation2d gyroAngle, SwerveModulePosition[] modulePositions) {
071    if (modulePositions.length != m_numModules) {
072      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
073          "Number of modules is not consistent with number of wheel locations provided in "
074              + "constructor");
075    }
076    return super.update(gyroAngle, modulePositions);
077  }
078}
